Bluelist — City Pop Theme Proposals

Three families, each in dark and light. All six are shown live below with the real tokens. Pick one family — nothing has been applied to src/ yet.

Dark mode

The default. Bluelist ships dark-first.

Light mode

Note how each family has to re-derive its brand colour for a light ground — bright aqua and neon magenta are unreadable as text on white, so B and C invert into deep, saturated ink versions.

How to choose

Document or interface? A treats the app as a printed page. C treats it as signage. B sits between.
How much is dense list content? Bluelist is mostly repeating rows. The louder the theme, the more that repetition costs.
Should the reference be legible to outsiders? B reads as "bright and tropical" to anyone. C reads as "vaporwave" specifically — the point, or the problem.

All six palettes pass WCAG AA: body and brand colours ≥ 4.5:1 against both page and card, disabled text and control borders ≥ 3:1. Fonts load from Google Fonts in this preview only; production is self-hosted WOFF2, subset, font-display: swap.
